thread:
carol-support: FYI — FizzyPay hit a sustained 429 spike starting ~08:15 UTC. They report ~20% error rate on chat completions. Requested quick triage and temporary relief.

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Yep, started after we rolled the new chat client. No server-side changes. Errors are mostly 429 rate_limited. Sample log: `429: quota_exceeded (TPM)`

mira-support: Can you paste a short repro or request pattern? Is it RPM or TPM that's tripping?

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Quick summary from our monitoring: observed RPM ~1.8k, configured RPM quota 3k. TPM observed ~65k in 5m windows, quota 60k. So TPM looks like the blocker.

devan-eng-sre: Thanks. Do you have an example client flow? e.g., messages/sec per session, concurrency per API key, streaming vs non-streaming?

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Repro script (dev environment) below — opens many websocket streams and sends very short user messages repeatedly:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 180); do
  websocat "wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?key=$API_KEY" -E &
  sleep 0.2
done
# then each connection sends a 6-10 char prompt every 1s
```

xavier-api: Two quick notes: 1) short prompts with a large system prompt / long assistant responses can inflate TPM quickly. 2) streaming fragments still count tokens as they're generated — high fanout of streams multiplies token accounting.

mira-support: Immediate mitigation options: reduce client concurrency, cap per-key concurrent streams, set `max_tokens`, and throttle system prompt size. We can also request a temporary TPM increase while you roll a fix.

fizzyops (FizzyPay): We're rolling a patch now to reduce per-client concurrency from 180 -> 40 and to add jitter on retries. Any quick config suggestions?

devan-eng-sre: Good. Also trim the system message — we saw many system tokens (~700 tokens per request) combined with 1-2 token user prompts. Set `max_tokens: 256` and enable prefix caching if you can. Add exponential backoff + jitter on 429s: `backoff = base * 2^attempt + rand(0, jitter)`

xavier-api: I'll open a tiny SDK patch that defaults to `concurrency: 50` for the streaming client and warns on very large `system` length. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/428 (canary coming).

deploy-bot: canary deploy of sdk client defaults to prod-5 started — will report back. :white_check_mark:

carol-support: I've opened enterprise ticket SUP-7892 and requested a 48h temporary TPM bump to 90k so FizzyPay doesn't hit 429s during rollout. Also scheduled a postmortem with them at 10:30 UTC.

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Thanks—applying concurrency cap and trimming system prompt now. Will monitor. Any metrics we should watch specifically?

devan-eng-sre: Watch 1) TPM 5m rolling, 2) percent 429s, 3) avg tokens per request, and 4) concurrent connections per API key. If 429s persist after client fix, upload a HAR/websocket trace and we'll trace per-request token attribution.

mira-support: Action items: (1) Temporary TPM bump requested (carol) (2) FizzyPay to deploy client patch (fizzyops) (3) Xavier to land SDK defaults PR and monitor canary (xavier) (4) Devan to follow up if 429s continue after fix (devan).

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Rolling now. Will report back in 15m with metrics. Thanks all. :pray:

carol-support: Thanks team — keeping channel open.

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Update (15m): concurrency cap -> 40 + system trim -> avg tokens/request dropped from ~720 -> ~120. TPM fell to ~38k and 429s dropped to <1%. Looks fixed from our side.

mira-support: Great news. We'll keep the temporary TPM bump request open until EOD and close if stable.

xavier-api: SDK PR merged to canary, patch released with defaults and a short note in changelog.

carol-support: I'll file a short postmortem template and attach repro script + graphs. Closing this thread once SUP-7892 is resolved.

fizzyops (FizzyPay): Appreciate the speedy help — will follow up after our internal postmortem.

Notes: - Root cause: client opened very high parallel streaming connections with oversized system prompt -> TPM exceeded even though RPM under quota. - Fixes: concurrency cap, trim system prompt, set max_tokens, add retry jitter, temporary TPM bump during rollout.
